title: First Exodus patent and a possible national security hold

tellings.quote:
Some patents apparently go through the
Department of Defense.

plain: A man named Charles, from a company called Exodus Propulsion, says that some patents, the legal protections for inventions, apparently get sent through the Department of Defense. He points to the Invention Secrecy Act of 1952, a US law that lets the government keep certain inventions secret for national security, and suggests their first patent may have been held up that way. If true, it would mean the government saw their work as sensitive enough to keep secret.
